Selected work
MGR.

From disconnected tools
to daily operations.

A brewery operations platform spanning product direction, interface design, architecture, and implementation. Built to support the way a brewery actually runs.

Explore the repository
THE CHALLENGE

The brewery’s previous setup with Ollie Ops left gaps in functionality, data access, and support for its workflows.

THE SYSTEM

Production, inventory, wholesale ordering, and customer access in one application. Integrations connect QuickBooks and Square, with AI-assisted operational features.

THE RESULT

MGR replaced Ollie Ops and is actively used for brewery operations.

Inside the architecture

The repository documents tenant isolation, traceable inventory history, and safe retries. AI-assisted changes use permission boundaries and confirmation steps.

How we work

From a process to a working system

Focus on one workflow, its rough edges, and the people who depend on it.

Understand the work

Build the workflow
